figurative_meaning_bn: কর্মবিপাক; কূট কৌশল; ঘটনাচক্র; দুর্বিপাক; ষড়যন্ত্র
figurative_meaning_en: Cycle of karma or events; cunning strategy; twists and turns of fate; misfortune; conspiracy
example_sentences_in_bangla: রাজনীতিতে এই পাকচক্র সবাইকে জড়িয়ে ফেলে।
example_sentences_in_english: The twists of fate turned his life upside down.
This political conspiracy entangled everyone involved.
note: The idiom often implies inevitable or manipulative turns in life events, deeply embedded in Bengali expressive language.
